messages.content: Selamat pagi. Saya Adrian Tan dari Engineering, Grab Malaysia. Project ID kami `proj-grab-driver-kyc-2026`, customer ID `cust-grab-002`. Kami nak roll out Number Verification API untuk re-verify 40,000 active driver phone numbers sebelum 30 Jun deadline LHDN. Boleh search verification products yang sesuai untuk Malaysian market dulu — query `silent_auth` dan `sms_otp`.
Selamat pagi Encik Adrian. Saya akan mencari produk pengesahan nombor untuk pasaran Malaysia sekarang. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

messages.name: search_verification_products
messages.content: {"products": [{"product_id": "prd-numver-silent-my", "name": "Number Verification Silent Auth (MY)", "methods": ["silent_auth"], "price_per_call_myr": 0.04, "sla_p99_ms": 280}, {"product_id": "prd-numver-smsotp-my", "name": "Number Verification SMS OTP (MY)", "methods": ["sms_otp"], "price_per_call_myr": 0.08, "sla_p99_ms": 4500}, {"product_id": "prd-numver-hybrid-my", "name": "Number Verification Hybrid (Silent + SMS Fallback)", "methods": ["silent_auth", "sms_otp", "flash_call"], "price_per_call_myr": 0.06, "sla_p99_ms": 800}], "pagination": {"total": 3, "page": 1}}
Hybrid product nampak balance — silent auth dulu, fallback SMS kalau gagal. Boleh get product details untuk `prd-numver-hybrid-my`, include pricing tiers dan compliance terms.
Baik Encik, saya akan mendapatkan butiran penuh produk Hybrid.

messages.name: get_verification_product_details
messages.content: {"product_id": "prd-numver-hybrid-my", "name": "Number Verification Hybrid", "pricing_tiers": [{"min": 0, "max": 9999, "price_per_call_myr": 0.08}, {"min": 10000, "max": 49999, "price_per_call_myr": 0.06}, {"min": 50000, "max": null, "price_per_call_myr": 0.04}], "sla": {"availability_pct": 99.95, "latency_p99_ms": 800}, "compliance": {"pdpa_my": true, "mcmc_certified": true, "data_residency": ["MY"]}, "rate_limits": {"per_second": 100, "per_minute": 5000, "burst": 200}, "supported_operators": ["maxis", "celcom", "digi", "u_mobile", "yes", "unifi_mobile"]}

Tier 40k calls = RM 0.06 per call = RM 2,400 total budget. Sebelum buat purchase, saya nak check eligibility untuk 5 sample MSISDN dulu — 60123456789, 60198888777, 60177766551, 60112233445, 60134455667 — supaya pastikan operator mix kami betul-betul covered.
Baik Encik, saya akan menyemak kelayakan untuk 5 nombor sampel sebelum kita meneruskan pembelian.

messages.name: check_number_eligibility
messages.content: {"results": [{"msisdn": "60123456789", "operator": "maxis", "eligible_methods": ["silent_auth", "sms_otp"], "silent_auth_supported": true}, {"msisdn": "60198888777", "operator": "digi", "eligible_methods": ["silent_auth", "sms_otp", "flash_call"], "silent_auth_supported": true}, {"msisdn": "60177766551", "operator": "celcom", "eligible_methods": ["silent_auth", "sms_otp"], "silent_auth_supported": true}, {"msisdn": "60112233445", "operator": "u_mobile", "eligible_methods": ["sms_otp", "flash_call"], "silent_auth_supported": false}, {"msisdn": "60134455667", "operator": "yes", "eligible_methods": ["sms_otp"], "silent_auth_supported": false}], "summary": {"silent_auth_coverage_pct": 60.0, "sms_fallback_coverage_pct": 100.0}}
60% silent auth, 100% SMS fallback — acceptable. Sekarang create pricing quote — 40,000 calls projection, dengan 60% silent, 40% SMS, currency MYR, 30-day validity.
Baik Encik, saya akan menjana sebut harga rasmi untuk projek pengesahan tersebut.

messages.name: create_pricing_quote
messages.content: {"quote_id": "qte-nv-grab-001", "customer_id": "cust-grab-002", "currency": "MYR", "items": [{"product_id": "prd-numver-hybrid-my", "unit_price_myr": 0.06, "projected_units": 40000, "subtotal_myr": 2400}], "total_myr": 2400, "valid_until": "2026-06-20T23:59:59+08:00"}
Quote RM 2,400. Create verification cart untuk customer ni — execution `bulk_batch` mode, batch_size 500 per request, project ID kita.
Baik Encik, saya akan mencipta troli pengesahan untuk pesanan pukal.

Sebenarnya pasukan operations dah confirm exact driver MSISDN — 40,000 numbers ada dalam file `s3://grab-kyc-2026/drivers-msisdn-batch-001.csv`. Boleh update cart dengan add upload source dan also pull cart details — saya nak verify state.
Baik Encik, saya akan mengemas kini troli dengan fail sumber dan menarik butiran troli secara serentak.

Sebab amount RM 2,400 dalam petty cash threshold, tak perlu approval khas. Boleh create verification checkout — billing_profile ID `bp-grab-corp-001`, terms accepted, currency MYR.
Baik Encik, saya akan memulakan checkout pengesahan rasmi.

messages.content: {"checkout_id": "chk-nv-grab-001", "cart_id": "cart-nv-grab-001", "status": "awaiting_payment", "total_due_myr": 2400, "created_at": "2026-05-21T10:04:02+08:00"}
Process payment menggunakan Maybank corporate banking — payment method enterprise_bank_transfer, reference `MBB-GRAB-2026-7788`.
Baik Encik, saya akan memproses pembayaran melalui pemindahan bank korporat.

messages.name: process_verification_payment
messages.content: {"payment_id": "pay-nv-grab-001", "status": "confirmed", "verification_order_id": "vord-nv-grab-001", "amount_charged_myr": 2400, "posted_at": "2026-05-21T10:04:48+08:00"}

Order dah created. Saya nak create first verification session untuk first MSISDN sample sebagai smoke test — target 60123456789 (Maxis), method_config hybrid (silent_auth primary, sms_otp fallback after 800ms timeout).
Baik Encik, saya akan mencipta sesi pengesahan ujian untuk MSISDN Maxis.

Do not share. — Grab"}}, "webhook_callback_url": "https://kyc.grab.com.my/numver/cb"}

Untuk test selesa, simulate customer submit OTP — boleh submit verification evidence dengan otp `448271` sebagai evidence.
Baik Encik, saya akan menyerahkan bukti pengesahan dengan OTP yang dimasukkan.

messages.content: {"verification_id": "ver-001", "evidence_id": "evd-001", "submission_status": "accepted", "submitted_at": "2026-05-21T10:06:11+08:00"}
Boleh check verification status untuk ver-001, dan in parallel tarik dependency graph order ni untuk see what's involved.
Baik Encik, saya akan menarik status pengesahan dan graf kebergantungan secara serentak.

messages.content: {"target_id": "vord-nv-grab-001", "nodes": [{"id": "vord-nv-grab-001", "kind": "verification_order"}, {"id": "chk-nv-grab-001", "kind": "checkout"}, {"id": "cart-nv-grab-001", "kind": "cart"}, {"id": "qte-nv-grab-001", "kind": "quote"}, {"id": "prj-grab-driver-kyc-2026", "kind": "project"}], "edges": [{"from": "vord-nv-grab-001", "to": "chk-nv-grab-001", "relation": "created_from"}, {"from": "chk-nv-grab-001", "to": "cart-nv-grab-001", "relation": "uses"}, {"from": "cart-nv-grab-001", "to": "qte-nv-grab-001", "relation": "priced_from"}]}

Smoke test berjaya — silent auth timeout (Maxis carrier latency), fallback SMS OTP berjaya. Tapi saya nak buat satu test scenario lagi — simulate verification that fails (wrong OTP), then retry dengan strategy `force_new_method sms_otp`.
Baik Encik, saya akan mencipta sesi tambahan untuk uji kegagalan dan mencuba semula dengan strategi yang dispesifikasikan.

messages.name: create_verification_session
messages.content: {"verification_id": "ver-002", "verification_order_id": "vord-nv-grab-001", "target_msisdn": "60112233445", "status": "otp_sent", "created_at": "2026-05-21T10:07:45+08:00"}

messages.content: {"verification_id": "ver-002", "evidence_id": "evd-002", "submission_status": "rejected", "reason": "otp_mismatch", "attempts_remaining": 2, "submitted_at": "2026-05-21T10:08:00+08:00"}
OTP rejected as expected. Now retry verification untuk ver-002 dengan strategy `force_new_method sms_otp` — generate OTP baru.
Baik Encik, saya akan mencuba semula pengesahan dengan kaedah baharu.

messages.name: retry_verification
messages.content: {"verification_id": "ver-002", "retry_id": "rty-002", "new_method": "sms_otp", "new_otp_sent": true, "attempts_remaining": 2, "executed_at": "2026-05-21T10:08:42+08:00"}

Sebab smoke test selesai dan tests work as expected, saya nak schedule bulk run untuk weekend supaya tak conflict dengan business hours. Schedule recurring verification order job untuk weekend, Sabtu 25 Mei 11pm, run sekali sahaja, batch 500 per minute.
Baik Encik, saya akan menjadualkan kerja pengesahan secara berperingkat untuk hujung minggu.

messages.name: schedule_recurring_verification_order_job
messages.content: {"scheduled_job_id": "sj-grab-001", "name": "grab-driver-kyc-bulk-saturday-night", "status": "scheduled", "next_run_at": "2026-05-24T23:00:00+08:00", "created_at": "2026-05-21T10:09:18+08:00"}

Aiyo, baru terima escalation dari Compliance team — mereka request bulk run di delay sebab MCMC audit data residency masih pending Friday. Saya nak cancel scope `scheduled_run` sahaja, tapi keep verification_order_id active supaya kami boleh re-schedule kemudian.
Baik Encik, saya akan membatalkan hanya jadual berperingkat tanpa membatalkan pesanan pengesahan utama.

Last step — generate executive PDF report untuk Compliance team supaya mereka boleh review, dan eksport verification order data ke S3 bucket `grab-kyc-evidence` prefix `2026-05-21-mcmc-review`.
Baik Encik, saya akan menjana laporan eksekutif untuk pasukan Compliance dan mengeksport data ke S3 secara serentak.

Berikut ringkasan Grab Driver KYC, Encik Adrian:

- **Verification order:** `vord-nv-grab-001` (40,000 driver MSISDN, hybrid Silent Auth + SMS OTP)
- **Quote / Checkout / Pembayaran:** `qte-nv-grab-001` / `chk-nv-grab-001` / `pay-nv-grab-001` — RM 2,400 dibayar via Maybank ref `MBB-GRAB-2026-7788`
- **Smoke test ver-001:** silent_auth timeout, SMS OTP berjaya — pengesahan kaedah hybrid berkesan
- **Negative test ver-002:** OTP salah ditolak dengan betul, retry method dilancarkan
- **Bulk run scheduled:** dibatalkan atas permintaan Compliance (MCMC residency pending)
- **Kesihatan order:** healthy, dengan tanda amaran kepatuhan untuk MCMC
- **Laporan PDF:** [rpt-vord-grab-001.pdf](https://reports.numver.my/r/rpt-vord-grab-001.pdf) — sudah dihantar ke Encik dan pasukan compliance
- **Eksport CSV:** `s3://grab-kyc-evidence/2026-05-21-mcmc-review/exp-vord-grab-001.csv.gz`

Apabila kelulusan MCMC diterima Jumaat ini, sila hubungi kami untuk reschedule bulk run sebelum 30 Jun deadline. Adakah ada apa-apa lagi yang saya boleh bantu?
Cukup, terima kasih banyak. Saya akan brief compliance team selepas ni dan tunggu MCMC clearance.

Sama-sama, Encik Adrian. Terima kasih atas kesabaran. Pasukan customer success kami akan memantau status MCMC dan akan maklumkan Encik sebaik sahaja jadual bulk run boleh diaktifkan semula. Selamat pagi.
